name: Puglia
about: August is scorching and packed with Italian domestic tourism (Ferragosto); spring and fall are far more comfortable.
overview: The whitewashed trulli of Alberobello, baroque Lecce, olive groves that produce more oil than anywhere else in Italy, and beaches on two different coasts — an increasingly popular, less-crowded alternative to Tuscany.
costOverview: Puglia is one of Italy's best values — a full plate of orecchiette at a trattoria costs less than half what you'd pay in Rome or Florence, and even a countryside masseria dinner stays reasonable.

festivals.label: La Notte della Taranta folk music festival

specialSeasons.text: August is Ferragosto — Italy's biggest domestic holiday month — and La Notte della Taranta, a huge open-air folk music festival in Salento.
